title: Modalities
description: The buyer's fulfilment request to the seller: consume-onsite, pickup, delivery, or virtual. Coordination (how a courier order is arranged across the DAG) is a sub-clause under delivery. Handoff (where the physical exchange happens) is a sub-clause that applies to any physical exchange — on-site, pickup, or delivery. Proximity verification of the handoff is the next sub-clause after handoff, carried by figaro-proximity-policy-v1, reconstructed under handoff in the drawer.

fields.name: modalities
fields.description: The buyer's request. A template offers one or more; a commitment carries the single chosen one. consume-onsite = consumed at the seller's premises. pickup = the buyer collects. delivery = a courier order carries it to the buyer. virtual = digital, no physical handoff.

fields.name: delivery
fields.description: Sub-clauses that apply only when the request is delivery. Surfaced under the delivery modality in the drawer.

fields.name: coordination
fields.description: How the courier order is coordinated across the DAG. seller-assigned = the seller's regular courier. buyer-assigned = the buyer picks the courier. dutch-auction = an open auction with no prior relationship.

fields.name: handoff
fields.description: Where the physical exchange happens — for on-site, pickup, or delivery.
